Does the doc explicitly defer the matrix reconciliation and Issue #62 to follow-on grains instead of claiming them?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism or resource risk: one comment deletion plus one markdown doc cannot change runtime behavior, test outcomes, or resource usage? Is there any retry/clock/randomness introduced? (There is none.)

scope.instructions: Anything beyond AF-12(i) hygiene: adapter changes, REST/MCP/UI wiring, migrations, donor imports, or unrelated refactors? The grain is exactly one lint fix plus one evidence doc — is that the smallest coherent release-hygiene step?

security.instructions: Do boundaries hold: the control-character guard is unchanged and still rejects unsafe input, no new input surface, no secret/egress/network change, no permission change? Does the doc make no upstream-compatibility claim (fixture-only adapters stay UNVERIFIED)?
